sources.title: RCW 74.42.450
sources.notes: app.leg.wa.gov's RCW template wraps the section's operative text (the numbered subsections and the bracketed history/notes line) in <div id='contentWrapper'>, which sits below the page's title/caption block and prev-next navigation and excludes both -- narrower than 'main-page-content' (a sibling container on this same page that includes the prev/next links and a 'field: Citations' metadata row neither of which this page quotes) and confirmed present in both the RCW and WAC templates this state cites, so one scope value serves both sources. Plain curl, no browser user-agent needed (200).

sources.title: WAC 388-97-0160, Discharge or leave of a nursing facility resident
sources.notes: Added deepening the page to full: WAC 388-97-0120(4)(b) names this section as the state's own source for the social/therapeutic bed-hold day count, and this is Washington's only located first-party statement of a number rather than a duty to have a policy. Same #contentWrapper container and plain curl already confirmed on this host for sources 1-2.

sources.title: WAC 388-02-0005, What is the purpose and scope of this chapter?
sources.source_date: no per-section date beyond the chapter's own filing history
sources.notes: Added deepening the page to full: chapter 388-02 is DSHS's general hearing-procedure chapter ("Regulates all hearings involving DSHS"), reached because RCW 74.42.450(5) requires a department discharge notice to carry a hearing-request form and names no office of its own; this section states the chapter's own scope, including that a specific DSHS program's hearing rules prevail over it where one exists. Same #contentWrapper container as sources 1-2.

sources.title: WAC 388-02-0025, Where is the office of administrative hearings located?
sources.source_date: no per-section date beyond the chapter's own filing history
sources.notes: Added deepening the page to full: the Office of Administrative Hearings' own address and phone, for the hearing right RCW 74.42.450(5)-(6) attaches to a department discharge decision. Same #contentWrapper container as sources 1-2.

sources.title: WAC 388-02-0100, How do you request a hearing?
sources.source_date: no per-section date beyond the chapter's own filing history
sources.notes: Added deepening the page to full: the chapter's own filing route (written or oral, and where to send a written request). Same #contentWrapper container as sources 1-2.

sources.title: WAC 388-02-0085, Do you have a right to a hearing?
sources.source_date: no per-section date beyond the chapter's own filing history
sources.notes: Added deepening the page to full: this section states that the filing deadline varies by DSHS program and are the one place the chapter states a specific number (ninety days, for public assistance cases under RCW 74.08.080), which this page cites only to show that number is scoped away from nursing-facility discharge, not carried as this state's discharge-appeal deadline. Same #contentWrapper container as sources 1-2.
